 Lone Pine follows a concentrated, research-driven approach focused on high-quality growth businesses.

 Holdings covered include:
META, AMZN, MSFT, TSM, UNH, INTU, CRM, BKNG, KKR, COF, SBUX, PM, ASML, EQT, APP, CVNA, LPLA, FLUT, BN, TLN, and more.

 This episode explores:• High-conviction portfolio construction• Growth-oriented sector allocation• How Lone Pine identifies long-term winners
